name: K21 IFV
protection: Fibreglass-composite/ceramic hull, amphibious with flotation bags. Game: immune to all small-calibre rounds; frontal arc resists 12.7/14.5 mm; 7.62x54R damages optics, tyres/tracks and exposed gear, 12.7/14.5 mm penetrates side and rear; all launchers penetrate.
visual_notes: Low two-man turret with 40 mm gun and smoke banks
Six road wheels per side; inflatable flotation sacks along the hull sides for swimming
Rear ramp door, large stowage bins on the turret rear
